images.prompt:
Premium Moonlit Meadow crochet-pattern branding with elegant serif typography, cream and warm-ivory neutrals, soft blush, dusty lavender and sage accents, and sparse crescent-moon and fine botanical watercolour ornaments used only in the branding layer. Every crochet visualisation is high-end photorealistic editorial product photography: genuine yarn fibres, distinct crochet stitches and loops, believable handmade depth and tiny irregularities, soft natural light, dimensional shadows and tactile neutral linen or interior styling. Calm romantic mood, crisp material detail, generous negative space, polished printable PDF design.

STYLE PARAMETERS: illustration style: Premium editorial product-photography system paired with restrained Moonlit Meadow branding: delicate watercolour botanical ornaments and crescent details appear only as secondary graphic accents, never within the crocheted product imagery.; line weight: Fine hairline rules and delicate ornamental strokes in the branding layer; no drawn outlines on product photography.; line quality: Precise, graceful and lightly organic in branding ornaments; not applicable to photographic product elements.; detail level: Crisp macro-level material detail for crochet visualisations, balanced with sparse, finely finished branding accents and generous calm space.; background density: Minimal and airy, using softly styled neutral interior or linen surfaces; branding ornaments remain sparse and peripheral.; composition: Clear editorial hierarchy with a single product focal point, generous breathing room for refined typography, and discreet ornamental framing that never competes with the crochet detail.; palette: Moonlit Meadow neutrals of cream, warm ivory and oat, with soft blush, dusty lavender and muted sage accents; charcoal-grey type used sparingly for elegant contrast.; colour mode: full colour; shading: Soft natural side lighting, realistic dimensional shadows and gentle tonal fall-off on yarn; subtle watercolour wash only in branding ornaments.; texture: Clearly visible yarn fibres, stitch loops, handmade irregularity and tactile linen or plaster texture; lightly textured watercolour paper feel confined to branding details.; mood: Romantic, restful and premium, with a quiet handmade botanical sensibility..

PAGE 1 of "Lavender Bloom Wall Hoop Crochet Pattern Bundle" (cover): Centred wooden embroidery hoop dressed with an asymmetrical arrangement of realistic crocheted botanical sprigs and leafy accents, pale plaster reading-nook wall, gentle late-afternoon side light, title text “LAVENDER BLOOM” with subtitle “WALL HOOP CROCHET PATTERN”, vertical clear title area below hoop, tiny peripheral crescent and botanical branding accents only.

CROCHET PRODUCT DIRECTION (authoritative for this crochet pattern product; it overrides any conflicting style, medium or avoid wording above). Two layers, never mixed:
1. BRANDING LAYER (Secondary decoration around the product: typography, background, ornaments and frames only.) Moonlit Meadow: a dreamy moonlit meadow, botanical identity; palette cream, warm ivory, soft blush, lavender, sage; tasteful crescent-moon details, fine botanical ornaments, elegant serif typography, subtle watercolour ornaments (allowed in the branding layer only). Feeling: romantic, premium, handmade. Any painted, illustrated or watercolour style above applies to this layer ONLY.
2. PRODUCT REPRESENTATION (The crocheted pieces themselves: the primary hero of every image they appear in.) The crochet pieces must look physically crocheted from yarn, photorealistic, high-end realistic product photography, clearly visible yarn fibres, visible crochet stitches, realistic loops, petal construction and stitch definition, genuine handmade depth and small imperfections, proper soft shadows and real dimensionality, believable yarn thickness, crochet stems, leaves and flowers where relevant. Styling: softly styled linen or neutral interior, soft natural light, clean premium editorial styling. Make the crochet piece large, with its yarn and stitch texture visible even at Etsy thumbnail size.
The crochet product must NOT look watercolour painted, hand illustrated, flat vector art, digitally painted, porcelain, plastic, like real biological flowers, like generic floral clipart.
A viewer must understand at a glance: "Those are crochet pieces made of yarn, and this listing contains crochet patterns."
CONCEPT / STYLE PROOF ONLY (the crochet patterns do not exist yet): this image establishes typography, palette, Moonlit Meadow branding, background, ornament style and general crochet realism. It is NOT the finished result of any specific pattern and NOT the final bundle: show a generic realistic crochet arrangement. Any flower types named above are mood references only; show no pattern count, no pattern names and no precise petal or leaf count as final.

CANVAS: A single portrait design with a plain white background. Keep a clear margin on every side; nothing important touches the edges, so it prints cleanly on a home printer. It is artwork for a printable crochet pattern collection (the cover or a representative page), following the CROCHET PRODUCT DIRECTION, and contains no written instructions, stitch diagrams, charts or step text. Use an airy printable A4 and US Letter-safe editorial layout with generous space for refined typography and unobtrusive pattern-document text. Any printed text must be short, correctly spelled and exactly as quoted.

DO NOT INCLUDE: Watercolour, illustration, vector rendering or painted effects on any crocheted piece; Generic floral clipart and dense decorative borders; Overcrowded layouts or excessive props; Misspelled text, illegible fine type or low-contrast lettering; Named flower species, fixed petal counts or specific pattern claims before patterns are approved; Logos, trademarks, copied brand styling or distinctive existing compositions; a crochet product that looks watercolour painted; a crochet product that looks hand illustrated; a crochet product that looks flat vector art; a crochet product that looks digitally painted; a crochet product that looks porcelain; a crochet product that looks plastic; a crochet product that looks like real biological flowers; a crochet product that looks like generic floral clipart.
